angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 514,897 km at 161.65 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.1863 +/- 0.0093 mas (same row, RUWE 0.99): 161.65 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.740113 +/- 0.06033 solar radii from TICv8, the stellar radius of HAT-P-18 b's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract): 514,897 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.773 +/- 0.075989 solar masses from TICv8, the stellar mass of HAT-P-18 b's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4790 +/- 107.64 K from TICv8, the stellar temperature of HAT-P-18 b's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: TICv8, the stellar temperature of HAT-P-18 b's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-18.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.588, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-18 (pscomppars): spectral type K2, from Hartman et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJ...726...52H/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HAT-P-18: main object type Em*, Emission-line Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-18 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.1 dex, from Esposito et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...564L..13E/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-18 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.58537, from Kirk et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017MNRAS.468.3907K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-18 (pscomppars): age 12.4 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-18 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.58 km/s, from Esposito et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014A&A...564L..13E/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
